name: p2pgpu
$comment: PINNING (D-0013). The builtin-baseline below IS the version pin — it fixes
the entire dependency graph, transitive deps included, to one vcpkg commit.
An overrides[] block is deliberately NOT used: it pins only direct deps and
survives a baseline bump, which is how you get direct deps held back while
their transitive deps move. The resolved versions are recorded in D-0013.
Updating dependencies = bump this one SHA, deliberately, as one diff.
There is NO default-features here on purpose. Every preset states its
features explicitly via VCPKG_MANIFEST_FEATURES, because the wasm preset
must NOT drag in uwebsockets/libdatachannel/sqlite3/blake3 for the
Adding anything not in the CONVENTIONS.md §10 baseline requires a
NOT here, by necessity — these come via FetchContent and need their own
pins, as the baseline does not cover them:
wgpu-native      : no vcpkg port; use the prebuilt release binaries
blake3 (wasm ONLY): the vcpkg port hardcodes x86 SIMD and does not build
for wasm32-emscripten. Native still uses the port;
only the browser worker fetches upstream (D-0034).
